_doc: Revert-verify mutants for ems__Bug 67e9be8b (create --validate re-read the frontmatter of every wikilink TARGET). SUBJECT: packages/cli/src/adapters/FileSystemVaultAdapter.ts — the frontmatter snapshot (withFrontmatterSnapshot + the memo read in getFrontmatter + forgetFrontmatter on every write path). Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute). One mutant per guard: the memo lookup, each write path's invalidation (§A6 — the shared helper is pinned branch by branch), the end-of-scope drop, nesting, the failure path. All mutants are TYPE-PRESERVING. `expect` filled ONLY from a completed driver run.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/cli/src/adapters/FileSystemVaultAdapter.ts

SM1_memo_never_consulted._note: The pre-fix read path: every getFrontmatter reads the disk even inside a snapshot (the memo is still written, never read).

SM2_memo_hit_answers_null._note: A memo that answers the wrong value: the walk would lose every target it had already read. Pins R2 (snapshot changes no triple).

SM3_modify_keeps_stale._note: modify (and so updateFrontmatter / process) no longer drops the path.

SM4_create_keeps_absence._note: create keeps a remembered null for a path it has just written.

SM5_delete_keeps_ghost._note: delete keeps the frontmatter of a file that is gone.

SM6_rename_keeps_old_path._note: rename forgets only the new path.

SM7_rename_keeps_new_absence._note: rename forgets only the old path.

SM8_updateLinks_keeps_stale.from:
// Rewrites files across the vault, outside `modify` — forget them all.
    this.forgetFrontmatter();
SM8_updateLinks_keeps_stale._note: updateLinks rewrites files through rewriteInboundWikilinks, not through modify.

SM9_forget_path_is_noop._note: The helper itself: a per-path forget that forgets nothing — every per-path axis at once.

SM11_memo_outlives_scope._note: The memory is never dropped — reads after the walk see what the walk saw.

SM12_inner_scope_drops_memo._note: A nested scope's end drops the outer memory.

SM13_inner_scope_restarts_memo._note: A nested scope's start replaces the outer memory.

SM14_failure_keeps_scope_open._note: A walk that throws leaves the depth at 1, so the memory is never dropped.

SM15_malformed_file_throws._note: Review LOW-1: resolvePath outside the try turns a malformed IFile into a TypeError instead of the pre-snapshot null.

_coverage._note_sets: Measured, not predicted: every set comes from a completed driver run (control 0 red). R6 and R11 were split into a/b after the first run gave SM12/SM13 and SM6/SM7 identical sets (§A110/§A147) — each now reddens its own axis.
_coverage._note_shared_set: SM8 and SM10 share R12 and that is ONE guard, not a vacuum: the argument-less branch of forgetFrontmatter has exactly one caller, updateLinks — SM8 removes the call, SM10 empties the branch, and both leave the same state.
_coverage._note_R2_R8: R2 (the snapshot changes no triple) is pinned by SM2; R8 (outside a snapshot every read is fresh) has no mutant here because no line of the diff is on that path — it is the pre-fix behaviour kept, guarded against a future always-on memo.
